editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: CXM Direct is an offshore broker registered in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines with no Tier-1 regulatory licence covering its retail clients. In 2026, it has zero Trustpilot reviews, no independently verified spread data, and an indirect FCA connection that does not provide you with FSCS protection or Financial Ombudsman access. The 1:2000 leverage is a risk amplifier marketed as a feature. NAFT cannot recommend depositing funds with a broker that has this regulatory profile when alternatives like IC Markets, Pepperstone, and Exness offer similar or better conditions under genuine Tier-1 oversight.
